summary: Iter 276 — Favorite drivers management + admin auto-dispatch favorite_head_start_seconds verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 10/10 passing (8 new HTTP integration + 2 existing helper tests). Frontend: user favorites page (login paul) supports add/remove/replace/max-2 disabling correctly; admin /admin/auto-dispatch 'Chauffeurs favoris — priorité' card persists value across reload. Rating-favorite storage fix (rides.py) confirmed by code review (writes to db.favorite_drivers with max-2 enforcement).
critical_code_review_comments: phase1.py GET /favorite-drivers, POST /favorite-drivers/{id}, DELETE /favorite-drivers/{id} — max-2 enforced (line 235), already-favorited is idempotent ($setOnInsert upsert), 404 on missing driver. Solid.
phase1.py GET /recent-drivers — correctly excludes already-favorited drivers, sorted by created_at desc, capped at 15, enriches with driver+user data. Good.
rides.py rate_ride() at line 2519 now persists favorite into db.favorite_drivers (same store the page reads) with max-2 silent enforcement — fix confirmed; previous separate field is no longer used.

auto_dispatch.py DEFAULT_CONFIG has favorite_head_start_seconds=20, AutoDispatchConfigUpdate accepts the field, PUT /admin/auto-dispatch/config persists and GET returns it nested under 'config'. Clamp 0..60 happens at read time via core/favorites.get_favorite_head_start_seconds — note: backend ACCEPTS values > 60 (e.g. 999) on the write path; only the dispatch consumer clamps. Minor: consider clamping in the writer to keep DB clean, but not a bug given the consumer guard.

FavoriteDriversPage.js — uses correct data-testids: favorite-drivers-page, fav-count, recent-drivers-section, add-{driver_id}, remove-{driver_id}, fav-{driver_id}, recent-{driver_id}, empty-state. Disabled state visually applied (bg-gray-100 text-gray-400) AND HTML disabled attr when atMax. Optimistic flow uses /api/phase1 with credentials:'include'.
AdminAutoDispatch.js — favorite-head-start-input testId present, save-config-btn writes via PUT /admin/auto-dispatch/config; field round-trips correctly (verified set 30 → reload → 30).
Cosmetic: NumberField uses parseInt(v) || 0 — fine, but a non-numeric paste becomes 0 silently. Acceptable for an admin UI.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Test reuses paul's seeded completed rides (drivers driver_93683151b54d & driver_27522f762b5d). Final state after UI run: paul has 2 favorites (driver_27522f762b5d + driver_93683151b54d). pytest test_zzz_final_cleanup leaves <=2. Admin favorite_head_start_seconds restored to original 25.
